equivalents.rationale: The unassigned publication cause is inspected only with isinstance against cancellation, KeyboardInterrupt and SystemExit. None and the empty string match none of those types; successful publication replaces the initial value before it is consumed.

Each production cancellation owner is acquired and retired once. After successful reset its token is never observed again; replacing the final cleared sentinel cannot alter context restoration or subsequent API calls, which allocate a fresh owner.
